steps.title: Wire saveSteppedResult + SteppedQuestionRunner into the real student session flow
steps.detail: Currently the stepped solver only exists behind a dev-only route (/dev/stepped, gated on NODE_ENV==='development' and dead-code-eliminated from production builds per src/App.js:93-98). StudentPage.js never imports SteppedQuestionRunner, and no production code path calls saveSteppedResult — grepped and confirmed only reference is its own definition in tokens.js.

steps.title: Confirm stepped-solver Firestore rules are deployed to production
steps.detail: The stepped-result rule branch (firestore.rules line 65) was committed 2026-07-21 (8dc5cf1), well after the last confirmed-deployed rules snapshot on record (2026-07-10, commit f4e9ca3). Emulator tests pass, but that only proves the rules file is internally correct — not that `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules` has been run since. This must be verified/deployed before step 6 goes live, or students could hit permission-denied on save.
steps.evidence: No deploy log, release-ruleset check, or commit evidence in-repo confirms a post-2026-07-21 rules deploy; memory note project_bp-tutor-firebase.md records only the 2026-07-10 deploy as confirmed

contradictions: PROJECT_STATUS.md (dated 2026-07-15, 'written at commit 2273a49') states Teacher Dashboard Phase 1 audit is done but 'implementation NOT started' and is 'BLOCKED ON: user confirmation of 3 definitions.' This is contradicted by later commits in the same repo (245705e 'feat: implement Teacher Dashboard Phase 1', plus ba5688c/ef55649/6429329/efb5610 building on it, all dated 2026-07-15/16) and by BP-Tutor_STATUS.md (dated 2026-07-25), which lists the Teacher Dashboard as a completed 'Prior Milestone (context)' that was 'reviewed and verified.' PROJECT_STATUS.md is a stale point-in-time handover doc, not current state.

PROJECT_STATUS.md's test count ('49/49 tests passing') is stale; the current suite (verified by running `npx react-scripts test --watchAll=false`) has 195 passing tests across 14 suites, plus a separate 22-test Firestore rules suite (`npm run test:rules`) not mentioned in PROJECT_STATUS.md at all (it predates the stepped-solver rules harness).

README.md's Data model / Key services tables do not mention the 'stepped' result type or steps 4-6 of the stepped solver at all (no saveSteppedResult, no stepped result ID shape, no DevSteppedPage) — README appears to not have been updated since before the stepped-solver work started (last README commit 9203653, 2026-07-17, precedes steps 1-6 which run 2026-07-20/21). Not a factual contradiction, but a currency gap worth flagging since it's a primary onboarding doc.

No committed doc besides BP-Tutor_STATUS.md addresses whether the 2026-07-21 stepped-result firestore.rules changes have actually been deployed to production (see roadmap step 7) — this is a gap/open question rather than a stated contradiction, but the working agreement documented in PROJECT_STATUS.md ('never deploy without explicit user confirmation') and BP-Tutor_STATUS.md's own 'Not yet wired to a production caller' suggest the feature is deliberately incomplete/undeployed, not an oversight.
